paite: Huan ngapi gilsung a kipan in TOUPA a Pathian kiang ah Jonah athum a, hichi in achi a;
heading: Jonah Thumna Leh Hotkhiakna
english: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

paite: "Ka haksatna ziak in TOUPA ka sam a, ama'n ahon dawng a; Sheol gilsung a kipan in ka kikou a, nang ka aw na zata hi.
english: He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.

paite: Thukpi ah, tuipi sunggil ah na hon pailut a, tui tampi ka kimvel ah a-oma; na tuikihot leh na tuikisep tengteng in ahon tum zel hi.
english: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.

paite: 'Huan na mitmuh a kipan paihkhiak ka hi a; himahleh na tempul siangthou lam ka nga nawn ding,’ ka chi hi.
english: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

paite: Tuite'n ka hinna tan in ahon umkimvel ua; tui thuk ka kim ka vel ah a-om hi; louhingte'n ka lu atuamsuak hi.
english: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.

paite: Tangte taw ah ka paisuk a; lei in tangtawn a ding in akalhnate'n ahon khakkhum a; himahleh nang Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, kohawm a kipan ka hinna na lakhia hi.
english: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, Yahweh my God.

paite: Ka sung a ka hinna abah lai in, TOUPA ka theigige ding a; na tempul siangthou ah ka thumna na kiang ahong tung hi.
english: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

paite: Thil gina lou leh zuau leltak limsak mite'n amau zahngaihna alehngatsan uh ahi.
english: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

paite: Ke'n zaw kipahthu genna aw toh na kiang ah kithoihna ka lan ding; ka chiamsa thu ka tangtun ding. Hotdamna TOUPA a ahi."
english: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ngapi ahoupih a, gam ah Jonah alokheta hi.
english: Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
